lifestream.text:
-- Main Travel --

/li → go to your home world
/li <world> → go to specified world
/li <datacenter> → go to a random world of specified data center
/li <aethernet> → go to specified aethernet destination
/li <world>, tp <location> → go to specified aetheryte destination of specified world
/li <world>, tp <aethernet> → go to specified aethernet destination of specified world

-- Market Board --

/li mb → go to market board
/li <world> mb → go to market board of specified world

-- Estates --

/li auto → go to your private estate, shared estate, FC estate or apartment, based on configured preference
/li shared → go to your shared estate, based on configured preference
/li home → go to your private estate, alias: /li home|house|private
/li fc → go to your FC estate, alias: /li fc|free|company|free company
/li apt → go to your apartment, alias: /li apt|apartment
/li ws → go to your FC's workshop, alias: /li ws|workshop
/li f <partial case-insensitive name> → teleport to friend's estate in the following order: private estate, apartment, fc.
/li fa <partial case-insensitive name> → teleport to friend's apartment.
/li fh <partial case-insensitive name> → teleport to friend's private estate.
/li ff <partial case-insensitive name> → teleport to friend's free company estate.

/li <district> <ward> <plot> → go to specified plot in current world
/li <world> <district> <ward> <plot> → go to specified plot of specified world
Examples: /li lavender 1 30, /li goblet 1 30, /li mist 1 30

-- Grand Company --

/li gc → go to your grand company, alias: /li gc|hcc
/li gc <grandcompany> → go to specified grand company, alias: /li gc|hcc <grandcompany>
/li gcc → go to your grand company city's FC chest, alias: /li gc|hcc
/li gcc <grandcompany> → go to specified grand company city's FC chest, alias: /li gc|hcc <grandcompany>
Using "hc" or "hcc" instead of "gc" or "gcc" moves to you to your home world first

-- Others --

/li cosmic → go to Cosmic Exploration area, alias: /li cosmic|moon|ardorum
/li island → go to Island Sanctuary
/li firmament → - go to Firmamnent
/li occult → Go to Occult Crescent North Horn
/li occult s → Go to Occult Crescent South Horn
/li w → open world travel window, alias: /li w|world|open|select
/li w <Character Name@World> → open world travel window for specified character, alias: /li w|world|open|select
/lifestream → open plugin configuration

simpletweaksplugin.text:
/tweaks → Open config window for Simple Tweaks
/bait <name or ID> → Switches fishing baits.
/chatvis show|hide|toggle → Provides commands to hide the chat.
/chrdir → Print your character save directory to chat. '/chrdir open' to open the directory in explorer.
/equipjob <job> → Switches to the highest item-level gearset for a job.
/equiprecommended → Equips recommended gear.
/estateaccess → Adds a command to open the estate access configuration for the current estate.
/estatelist <friend> → Opens the estate list for one of your friends.
/leaveduty → Leave the current duty
/levelingdungeon → Open the highest level leveling dungeon.
/lights (0-5) [ssao-on | ssao-off] [save] → Adjust the lighting of the house or apartment you are currently in.
/maincommand <command> → Execute a Main Command
/minionaway → Adds a command to dismiss your current minion.
/phantomjob [job] → Adds a command to switch phantom jobs within Occult Crescent
/pid → Print your process id to chat.
/playerplate → Opens the character card for the selected character.
/setoption <option> <value> → Usage: /setoption <option> <value>
/stopcrafting → Stops crafting without closing the crafting log.
/updategearset → Updates the active gearset with your current equipment.
/usecollection <name or ID> → Use a Collection item by name or ID. Use without parameters to list available items and IDs.

artisan.text:
/artisan → Opens the Artisan menu.
/artisan lists → Open Lists.
/artisan lists <ID> → Opens specific list by ID.
/artisan lists <ID> start → Starts specific list by ID.
/artisan macros → Open Macros.
/artisan macros <ID> → Opens specific macro by ID.
/artisan endurance → Open Endurance.
/artisan endurance start|stop → Starts or stops endurance mode.
/artisan settings → Open Settings.
/artisan workshops → Open FC Workshops.
/artisan builder → Open List Builder.
/artisan automode → Toggles Automatic Action Execution Mode on/off.

gatherbuddy.text:
/gatherbuddy → Use to open the GatherBuddy interface.
/gather → Mark the nearest node containing the item supplied, teleport to the nearest aetheryte, equip appropriate gear.
You can use 'alarm' to gather the last triggered alarm or 'next' to gather the same item as before, but in the next-best location.
/gatherbtn → Mark the nearest botanist node containing the item supplied, teleport to the nearest aetheryte, equip appropriate gear.
/gathermin → Mark the nearest miner node containing the item supplied, teleport to the nearest aetheryte, equip appropriate gear.
/gatherfish → Mark the nearest fishing spot containing the fish supplied, teleport to the nearest aetheryte and equip fishing gear.
/gathergroup → Teleport to the node of a group corresponding to current time. Use /gathergroup for more details.
/gbc → Some quick toggles for config options. Use without argument for help.

/allagantools (or /atools) → Shows the allagan tools items list window.
/openlist <list> → Open/closes a window displaying the contents of a single list.
/athighlight <list> (or /atf) → Toggles the specified list's highlight on/off, turning off any other highlighting in the process.
/atclearall [background|ui] → Closes all list windows and clears all active highlighting. Pass in background or ui to close just the background or ui highlighting respectively.
/moreinfo <item> (or /itemwindow) → Opens the more information window for a specific item. Provide the name of the item or the ID of the item.
/crafts → Opens the allagan tools crafts window
/craftoverlay → Toggles the crafting overlay window.
/airships → Opens the allagan tools airships window
/submarines → Opens the allagan tools submarines window
/retainerventures → Opens the allagan tools retainer ventures window
/duties (or /atduties) → Shows the allagan tools duties window.
/mobs (or /atmobs) → Shows the allagan tools mobs compendium.
/atnpcs → Shows the allagan tools npcs window.
/compendium (or /atc) → Shows the allagan tools compendium window.
/compendiumlist (or /atclt) → Toggle a specific compendium list window.
/chocobocolour (or /atcc) → Toggles the chocobo colour calculator window.
/atconfig → Opens the allagan tools configuration window
/athelp → Opens the allagan tools help window

autohook.text:
/autohook (or /ahcfg) → Opens Config Window
/ahon → Enables AutoHook
/ahoff → Disables AutoHook
/ahtg → Toggles AutoHook On/Off
/ahstart → Start casting with your selected preset
/ahpreset <preset name> → Set custom preset by chat command -> /ahpreset presetName
/agpreset <preset name> → Set Autogig preset by chat command -> /agpreset presetName
/ahbait <name or ID> (or /bait) → Switches fishing baits (by Name or ID)
/ahreplay → Opens Replay Window
/ahfish [fish name or ID] → Opens the Fish Data window. Add an optional fish name or id to open to that fish.

bossmod.rule: {"lines":[["/vbm","show boss mod settings UI"],["/vbm r","show/hide replay management window"],["/vbm ar","toggle autorotation ui"],["/vbm ar clear","clear current preset; autorotation will do nothing unless plan is active"],["/vbm ar disable","force disable autorotation; no actions will be executed automatically even if plan is active"],["/vbm ar set <preset>","start executing specified preset, and deactivate others"],["/vbm ar toggle","force disable autorotation if not already; otherwise clear overrides"],["/vbm ar toggle <preset>","start executing specified preset unless it's already active; clear otherwise"],["/vbm ar activate <preset>","add specified preset to active list"],["/vbm ar deactivate <preset>","remove specified preset from active list"],["/vbm ar togglemulti <preset>","if specified preset is in active list, disable it, otherwise enable it"],["/vbm ai","toggle multibox ui"],["/vbm ai on","enable AI mode"],["/vbm ai off","disable AI mode"],["/vbm ai toggle","toggle AI mode"],["/vbm ai follow <name>/slot<N>","enable multibox mode and follow party member with specified name or at specified slot"],["/vbm cfg <config-type> <field> [<value>]","query or modify configuration setting"],["/vbm d","show debug UI"],["/vbm gc","execute C# garbage collector"],["/vbm clear-maps","clear all generated bitmaps (for pathfinding)"],["/vbm macro","enables VBM action queue inside macros (by default, any actions used in macros bypass the queue)"],["/vbm macro-off","disables VBM action queue inside a macro, if it has been enabled previously"],["/vbm helpme","gather diagnostic information"],["/vbmai","alias for /vbm ai","alias for "]]}
bossmod.text:
/vbm → show boss mod settings UI
/vbm r → show/hide replay management window
/vbm ar → toggle autorotation ui
/vbm ar clear → clear current preset; autorotation will do nothing unless plan is active
/vbm ar disable → force disable autorotation; no actions will be executed automatically even if plan is active
/vbm ar set <preset> → start executing specified preset, and deactivate others
/vbm ar toggle → force disable autorotation if not already; otherwise clear overrides
/vbm ar toggle <preset> → start executing specified preset unless it's already active; clear otherwise
/vbm ar activate <preset> → add specified preset to active list
/vbm ar deactivate <preset> → remove specified preset from active list
/vbm ar togglemulti <preset> → if specified preset is in active list, disable it, otherwise enable it
/vbm ai → toggle multibox ui
/vbm ai on → enable AI mode
/vbm ai off → disable AI mode
/vbm ai toggle → toggle AI mode
/vbm ai follow <name>/slot<N> → enable multibox mode and follow party member with specified name or at specified slot
/vbm cfg <config-type> <field> [<value>] → query or modify configuration setting
/vbm d → show debug UI
/vbm gc → execute C# garbage collector
/vbm clear-maps → clear all generated bitmaps (for pathfinding)
/vbm macro → enables VBM action queue inside macros (by default, any actions used in macros bypass the queue)
/vbm macro-off → disables VBM action queue inside a macro, if it has been enabled previously
/vbm helpme → gather diagnostic information
/vbmai → alias for /vbm ai

honorific.rule: {"lines":[["/honorific","Open the Honorific config window."],["/honorific title <enable|disable|toggle> <title>","Enable, Disable, or Toggle a title on the current character."],["/honorific force set <title> | [prefix|suffix] | #<HexColor> | #<HexGlow>","Sets a title that will override all other configured titles."],["/honorific force clear","Clear the forced title."]]}
honorific.text:
/honorific → Open the Honorific config window.
/honorific title <enable|disable|toggle> <title> → Enable, Disable, or Toggle a title on the current character.
/honorific force set <title> | [prefix|suffix] | #<HexColor> | #<HexGlow> → Sets a title that will override all other configured titles.
/honorific force clear → Clear the forced title.

autoretainer.text:
/autoretainer → Open plugin interface
/ays - alias for /autoretainer
/autoretainer e|enable → Enable plugin
/autoretainer d|disable - Disable plugin
/autoretainer t|toggle - toggle plugin
/autoretainer m|multi - toggle MultiMode
/autoretainer relog Character Name@WorldName - relog to the targeted character if configured
/autoretainer b|browser - open venture browser
/autoretainer expert - toggle expert settings
/autoretainer debug - toggle debug menu and verbose output
/autoretainer shutdown <hours> [minutes] [seconds] - schedule a game shutdown in this amount of time
/autoretainer itemsell - begin selling items to NPC or retainer if possible
/autoretainer het - enter nearby own house or apartment if possible
/autoretainer reset - reset all pending tasks
/autoretainer deliver - deliver expert delivery items
/autoretainer armoire - deliver all eligible items into armoire
/autoretainer dresser - deliver all eligible items into glamour dresser (requires Glamour Log plugin)
